correctness.rationale: For every finite degree and including degree zero, the candidate proves that nongroup partial injections yield inverse-generation fibers of size two using integer path displacement and missing-edge separation. Group-type fibers equal Euler totient of the permutation order. The partition sum counts cyclic subgroups correctly. Exponential path/cycle decompositions yield the exact nilpotent count, and a detailed Cauchy saddle analysis with angular error bounds gives the sharp leading constants. All finite exhaustive closure tests through degree six match. No infinite conclusion rests on finite checks.

value.rationale: The natural quantity is the number of distinct embedded one-generated inverse submonoids, not abstract isomorphism types. The full-sequence exact formula captures a nontrivial cyclic-group correction, the chain rigidity proves a structural generator classification, and the sharp square-root nilpotent submonoid proportion identifies behavior invisible in the previously published type count. This supplies an intrinsic counting invariant and asymptotic typical-submonoid law, not a small unmotivated computation.
